content.title: About
content.content: Fruit juice blend is a 100% natural juice made from a mix of citrus fruits (orange, mandarin, grapefruit, lemon). The juice contains no added sugar, preservatives or colourings. It offers a bright aroma, refreshing taste and a high vitamin C content.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The juice is produced from carefully selected fruits grown without pesticides.
Citrus fruits are rich in flavonoids that help protect blood vessels.
In 2022 the product received an “Organic” certification for meeting ecological standards.
The juice is packaged in dark‑glass bottles that protect vitamin C from light degradation.
Each 250 ml bottle provides more than 70 % of the adult daily recommended intake of vitamin C.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immunity, supports collagen synthesis and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: The juice is almost entirely water, helping to maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium aids normal heart and muscle function.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: 100 ml of juice contains about 45 kcal, making it suitable for diet‑friendly nutrition.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Flavonoids and carotenoids in citrus help combat free radicals.

items.title: Citrus allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to citrus fruits.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The high acidity can irritate the stomach lining in people with gastritis or ulcers.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Large doses of vitamin C may affect the efficacy of certain medications, such as anticoagulants.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: The juice is best served chilled, optionally diluted with water. It can be used in smoothies, cocktails, marinades, and as a base for fruit desserts.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bottle in the refrigerator at 2 °C–8 °C. Once opened, consume within 5 days. Do not freeze.
